theorem_title: Exclusion of an infinitely repeated affine block
natural_language_statement:
Let $b,d,c\in\mathbb N$ with $\gcd(b,b+d)=1$ and $b>1$, and let $x:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ satisfy $d x_0+c>0$. Then

$$
\neg\bigl(\forall i\in\mathbb N,\ b x_{i+1}=(b+d)x_i+c\bigr).
$$

Only the displayed fixed block is excluded; this does not exclude every nonconvergent Collatz itinerary.
